task.title: Households: shared recipe books, meal plans and shopping lists across users
task.description:
## Idea (captured from the owner by voice, 2026-11-18; not yet specced)

Several users can indicate that they belong to one shared household.

What the owner described:
- Recipe books can be shared within the household.
- Shopping lists can be shared within the household.
- Planning has a household side: yield and portions depend on who is eating. Individual users may still have their own individual meals on some days, so a plan is not all-or-nothing shared.

## Why it is filed now

The Weekly Meal Planner spec has an open question "single user or household". This story is the owner's answer in direction, not in detail: household support is wanted eventually. The planner's data model should not make it hard (for example, the prototype has a single "people cooked for" number and owner-only storage).

## To work out when this is picked up

- How a household is formed and left: invite, accept, who can remove whom.
- What is shared by default and what stays personal (recipes, plans, lists, nutrition targets).
- Per-slot attendance: who eats which meal, and how that drives portions and the shopping list.
- Whether nutrition targets and tracking are always per person.
- Today every table in the app is scoped to one user; sharing changes authorization across recipes, grocery lists and the planner.
